   9:         f"Customer: {invoice.customer}",
  10:         f"Issued: {invoice.issued.isoformat()}",
  11:         "",
  12:     ]
  13:     for line in invoice.lines:
  14:         out.append(f"{line.quantity:>3} x {line.description:<20} {line_total(line):>10}")
  15:     out.append("")
  16:     out.append(f"{'Subtotal':<26} {subtotal(invoice):>10}")
  17:     if invoice.discount_code is not None:
  18:         label = f"Discount ({invoice.discount_code})"
  19:         out.append(f"{label:<26} {-discount(invoice):>10}")
  20:     invoice_tax = tax(invoice)
  21:     if invoice_tax != 0:
  22:         out.append(f"{'Tax':<26} {invoice_tax:>10}")
  23:     out.append(f"{'Total':<26} {total(invoice):>10}")
  24:     return "\n".join(out) + "\n"
